notes: New playlists and saved song lists now appear in the player right after saving in the DLC Shop, without reloading the page.
Playlists and alignment now load from the saved config through the config API (the widget previously read the stock checkout config.json, so saved playlists never appeared).
The player now releases its timer and document listeners when the widget is unmounted.
Ships blank: no bundled sample track.
Accepts more audio formats (flac, aac, opus, aiff, wma, m4b, and more).
Clearer empty-state hints pointing to the DLC Shop; docs updated to the library/playlists model.
Shared song library. Playlists assign existing tracks with checkboxes — no per-playlist re-upload.
Playlist-only player: no reserved music/ambient mode. Users pick a playlist and a song from a list.
Player bar and settings list follow app Looks (Neon, Wood, Paper, Stone, Velvet) and color palettes.
Widget alignment: align the player left, center, or right in the top bar (config.align).
Removed the generative synth: the player only plays uploaded audio files.
Multiple playlists: every folder inside the plugin is a playlist with its own track order.
Only audio files (mp3, ogg, wav, webm, m4a) appear in playlists — README and other files are ignored.
Playlist order: reorder tracks in the DLC shop; playback follows the configured order (top first).
Initial release: generative ambient music player for the top bar.
